Andy Bianchedi has managed a Milan family office since 2017, investing across real estate, public securities, venture capital and associated companies. Created with his mother, Hillary Merkus Recordati, the platform was formed to invest proceeds from their family pharmaceutical-business sale. Its investments include companies in artificial intelligence, biotechnology and Italian manufacturing.

Its cultural and educational work includes a partnership with the University of Florence and support for contemporary artists through Palazzo Strozzi. He also serves on the cultural institution’s governing board and has received the Keys to the City of Florence for his philanthropy.
